{{Quote|Bravo! Bravo! An excellent showing! I am Schnil Hakoon. I see that these fools have failed in their mission to recover the Amber Eye, for none of you is Pierce Mantrell. You are, however, from the ship which arrived earlier today. Attend me. I wish to make you an offer.|Schnil Hakoon propositions a group of undercover Rebel agents on Kirtania|<ref name="QM" />}}
'''Schnil Hakoon''' was a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who functioned from the city of [[Kinkosa City]]. Hakoon settled on [[Kirtania]], from [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]], after learning that insects were plentiful within the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] environment. To increase his wealth and power in the insect [[Farm/Legends|farming]] market, he turned to crime and hired the [[Ebon Coursers]] mercenaries to be his personal body guards.

==Biography==
Born on [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]], the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] Schnil Hakoon was a businessman and innovator. His family on Kubindi owned the patent on several breeds of designer [[Insect/Legends|insect]] used in Kubaz cuisine, and Hakoon's goal was to corner the market on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. With Kubaz cuisine gaining high status amongst the more adventurous members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] corps, Hakoon traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]] as he had heard that the world was teeming with insect life. Hoping to corner the market in insect farming on the planet, he established himself as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] in order to raise the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|capital]] for his [[Farm/Legends|agricultural]] endeavours. Hakoon soon became known as the being to go to for black market goods in [[Kinkosa City]]. He established a [[Schnil Hakoon's headquarters|headquarters]] in the [[City/Legends|city]], and hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] known as the [[Ebon Coursers]] to serve him. Hakoon also owned the [[Amber Eye]], a smooth, palm-sized [[amber]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] with a rare insect trapped inside that was valued at 35,000 credits.<ref name="QM" />

At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Pierce Mantrell]] broke into Hakoon's headquarters and stole the Amber Eye. Incensed, Hakoon set the Ebon Coursers to recover the Eye. The gang encountered a group of undercover [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents at [[Kinkosa Starport]], and mistook one of them for Mantrell as one of the group resembled the thief immensely. A [[lightfight]] ensued, and an Imperial patrol intervened, confiscating the participants' weapons. Hakoon witnessed the affray, and offered the undercover Rebels a deal while meeting in a local [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]; he had discovered that the Rebel's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was low on food and water. In exchange for supplies&mdash;including weapons to replace those taken by the Empire&mdash;they would hunt Mantrell and recover the Amber Eye. As his men had searched the starport thoroughly, and Hakoon was sure Mantrell had not escaped on a ship, then the Kubaz reasoned that Mantrell must have gone into the nearby [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forest]]. The Rebels, needing supplies and aware that they could accomplish Hakoon's goal while they were carrying out their own mission&mdash;searching for wanted [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]] to procure [[Shiarha Root]] to treat an outbreak of [[Direllian Plague]]&mdash;agreed. Hakoon advised them to contact the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in the cantina they were meeting in once they had succeeded.<ref name="QM" />

{{RPG}}
After returning from the rain forest having successfully completed the mission, the Rebels contacted Hakoon through the bartender. Good to his word, he had restocked their ship and he sneaked them aboard their vessel in crates as the local Imperial authorities had learned of the Rebels association with Kith'Araquia and his Araquian tribesmen.<ref name="QM" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Hakoon was trained to use a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and was knowledgeable about [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedures, insect farming, and the goings-on on Kirtania.<ref name="QM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Schnil Hakoon appeared in ''[[The Quality of Mercy]]'', an [[Roleplaying game|RPG adventure]] written by [[Nicky Rea]] published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]] by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. If the players failed to recover the Amber Eye for Hakoon, he is angry at the players and will set the Ebon Coursers on them at a later date. In addition, the players will have to figure out an alternative method of getting aboard their ship undetected. This article assumes that the player characters successfully completed the task as recommended.
